## Demo console
Open **http://localhost:5678/webhook/console** in a browser. The buttons run the three automations through their "Run from console" triggers.

### Show the console
Reads all data and renders the page.

### Console buttons
Runs the chosen automation, then returns to the console with its summary.

meta.description: The web page used in demos: live view of timesheets, compliance, umbrella checks, outbox and payroll exports, with buttons to run each automation.
